long_biography.plain_text:
Paul Fireman first encountered golf as a ten-year-old caddie in Brockton, Massachusetts, where golfers invited him into adult conversations. The former Reebok chief later created Liberty National with his son Dan, turning an industrial waterfront in Jersey City into a championship course. Dan managed the development and recruited its first members.

Fireman also made youth golf a sustained charitable commitment. He became a First Tee trustee in 2012, and his family's funding has supported its national programmes and four New Jersey chapters. The organisation uses golf to teach young people confidence and life skills, on and off the course.
